CONTEXT_WINDOW = 8000
OUTPUT_RESERVE = 1000
INPUT_BUDGET = CONTEXT_WINDOW - OUTPUT_RESERVE  # 7000
SYSTEM_TOKENS = 500

DOCS = [
    ("doc1", 3000),
    ("doc2", 2500),
    ("doc3", 1500),
    ("doc4", 2000),
]


def pack(docs, budget, system_tokens):
    used = system_tokens
    included = []
    for name, tokens in docs:
        if used + tokens <= budget:
            included.append(name)
            used += tokens
    return included, used


included, used = pack(DOCS, INPUT_BUDGET, SYSTEM_TOKENS)
for name, tokens in DOCS:
    if name in included:
        print(f"{name}: included ({tokens} tokens)")
    else:
        print(f"{name}: skipped (would exceed budget)")
print(f"input tokens used: {used} / {INPUT_BUDGET}")
